agent.problem: The important statement in Haggai 2:14 that every work of the people's hands is defiled is never clearly communicated. This card quotes only the people-and-nation clause before moving into its joke, and card 9 asks only about their offerings. The later statement that their work was struck with blight, mildew and hail does not supply the missing detail that their work was defiled.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
